market_summary: London morning session displays EURUSD breaking above session VWAP and EMA50 towards VAH/Session High with positive delta momentum. GBPUSD exhibits clear bearish delta divergence near VAH, warranting a pause. BTCUSD trades weak below session VWAP and Value Area Low but is stalling directly above local structural support on thin volume.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7-point confluence checklist: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.10701, VAH 1.10923) and trading above POC 1.10757, challenging VAH. 2) CVD: CVD is +564.11 labeled NEUTRAL with an accelerating positive slope (+1108.64) supporting the upside impulse. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, active market hours. 4) Trend/Baselines: Price has reclaimed and is holding above session VWAP (1.10833) and EMA50 (1.10867). 5) ATR: Testing near the upper ATR band (1.10928) with expanding volatility. 6) Volume/RVOL: RVOL is 1.887, reflecting solid momentum without an extreme exhaustion spike. 7) Levels: The forming bar sweeps past Prev Low support and advances toward Session High (1.10988); GEX is null. Clean upward momentum favours a scalp long towards the session high.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7-point confluence checklist: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32531, VAH 1.32729) and above POC 1.32577, pressing directly against VAH. 2) CVD: Strongly BEARISH at -3091.86 with negative slope (-827.86), directly diverging from the price attempt to push higher. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend/Baselines: Price is hovering right at EMA50 (1.32687) and slightly above VWAP (1.32649) with mixed directional clarity. 5) ATR: Moving towards upper ATR band (1.32761). 6) Volume/RVOL: RVOL is 1.123 (normal volume, no breakout confirmation). 7) Levels: Facing immediate resistance at VAH and Session High at 1.32809 while CVD diverges negatively; GEX is null. signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7-point confluence checklist: 1) Volume Profile: Price is below VAL (73427.34) and below POC (73549.74), showing net bearish positioning. 2) CVD: BEARISH (-0.03) with flat slope, showing weak participation. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend/Baselines: Firmly below both VWAP (73650.19) and EMA50 (73704.29) with negative trajectory. 5) ATR: Mid-to-lower band region with contracting volatility. 6) Volume/RVOL: Very low RVOL of 0.297 with no volume spikes, signaling a low-liquidity drift rather than an active breakout. 7) Levels: Sitting right on top of local S/R support (73386.8) and near Session Low (73313.1); GEX is null. Selling into direct immediate support on anemic volume carries poor risk-reward; hence HOLD is prudent.
